messages.subject: Heim 90-ton brake and GMC shear, Lewisville TX
messages.body:
Hi MFO purchasing team,

I’m Nick Gonzales in Dallas. I’m evaluating a two-machine package for resale: a Heim 90-ton, 10-foot mechanical press brake and a GMC 10-foot, 14-gauge shear in Lewisville.

The seller lists back-gauge and die tooling, gives the brake’s weight as 8,500 lb, and offers an operating video. Rigging and collection need arranging.

Would you make an outright purchase offer on this equipment? I’d like an indicative price for the pair and separate values where practical, net of any removal charges. What photos and checks would your buyer need to firm it up?

Thanks,
Nick

messages.subject: Purchase bid for pallet-rack lot in Vader, WA
messages.body:
Hi Conesco team,

I’m evaluating a dismantled rack lot in Vader, Washington for purchase and resale: 250-plus beams in mixed lengths, roughly 400 shelf supports, five upright frames and spacers. The seller offers forklift loading. The stock has been stored outside.

The listed groups include 77 matching blue beams at 8 ft 9 in and 45 orange beams at 8 ft. I’m checking connector styles, condition and the rest of the dimensions.

Could your Northwest buyer give an indicative outright price including collection? Please flag any groups you would exclude and the photos or checks needed for a firm bid.

Thanks,
Nick Gonzales

messages.subject: Buyback prices for two sealed Canon and Dell toner lots
messages.body:
Hi TonerG team,

I’m evaluating two small OEM toner lots for resale. Could you quote them separately, subject to checking the original box labels and seals?

Conroe, Texas: one each Canon 054H black and cyan, plus 054 standard yellow and magenta. These four are described as unopened original boxes; I’m excluding an additional opened cartridge.

Covina, California: five Dell 5110CN cartridges in original sealed boxes. Two black CT200840 / GD898, one cyan CT200841 / GD900, one magenta CT200842 / KD557, and one yellow CT200843 / JD750.

Please include your prepaid shipping terms and whether advance payment is available after reviewing the photos. These are prospective purchases, not inventory I own yet.

Thanks,
Nick Gonzales

messages.subject: 2016 CAMaster Panther 408 package, Los Angeles
messages.body:
Hi Resell CNC team,

I’m evaluating a 2016 CAMaster Panther 408 in Boyle Heights, Los Angeles for purchase and resale. The seller describes fewer than 1,000 hours and a working single-phase setup with a 5 hp HSD spindle, Black Box Hurricane vacuum, dust collector, WinCNC PC and wired remote.

Would this fit your current buying list? I’m looking for an indicative outright purchase price with removal included, subject to your inspection. Please tell me the photos, control details and operating checks you need to firm up a bid.

Thanks,
Nick Gonzales

messages.subject: Rigging quote: press brake and shear in Lewisville
messages.body:
Hi IMM team,

Please quote rigging for a prospective purchase in Lewisville: a Heim 90-ton, 10-foot mechanical press brake, listed at 8,500 lb, and a GMC 10-foot, 14-gauge shear whose weight I’m confirming.

I need two options: load both onto a buyer-arranged truck, or load and deliver within 30 road miles in DFW. For preliminary pricing, assume ground-floor access; doorway clearance, power disconnection and exact dimensions still need checking.

Could you give a budget range, your site-survey charge if needed, and the details required for a firm quote? Please separate transport, unloading and any minimum crew charges.

Scheduling is flexible. This is a quote request, not a booking or instruction to visit the seller.

Thanks,
Nick Gonzales
